$schema.description: Optional path or URL of the JSON Schema, for editors (ignored by `lab`).

lab.description: The lab to boot: a name (`labs/<lab>.json` in win-test-lab, e.g. `school`) or a path to a lab file, relative to this run file (e.g. `./lab.json`). A value with a `/` or `\` or ending in `.json` is a path.

name.description: Label for the results folder (default: the run file's stem).

wait.description: Seconds a step may run before it counts as "still running" (default 60).

timeout_min.description: Give up on the whole run after this many minutes (default 60).

mount.description: Host folder for each drive letter, e.g. `{ "X": "./app" }` (read-only in the guest).

on.description: Where to run: a machine name, a list of names, or `all` (every member, not the DC). Default `all`.

as.description: Who to run as: `system` (full rights) or a user name. Default: the user logged on to that machine (its `logon` user, else Administrator). A step on the DC needs an `as`.

expect_exit.description: Exit code that counts as success (default 0).

wait.description: Seconds this step may run before it counts as "still running" (default: the run's `wait`).

keep_running.description: If true, a program still running at `wait` counts as OK and is left running.

OnSpec.description: a machine name, a list of machine names, or "all" (every member)
